items.decision: package udev rule 60-macbook91-nvme-d3cold.rules (DMI-gated), set live in install scriptlet; the packaged rule is the only one the package knows
items.risk_rollback: no test without the setting (would risk the root disk); removing the package drops the rule at next boot
items.acceptance: after reboot: d3cold_allowed=0 from the packaged rule; NVMe I/O ok in every suspend cycle; no nvme kernel errors

evidence.ref: pci.c pci_dev_check_d3cold, pci.h pci_power_manageable, pci-driver.c:948 suspend_noirq; nvme/host/pci.c no pm_runtime

items.component: Battery charge limit (SMC key BCLM, ACPI SBS BAT0)
items.capability: stop charging at a user-chosen level (charge_control_end_threshold), settable in Plasma
items.problem: in-tree applesmc exposes no charge limit; PowerDevil: 'Charge thresholds are not supported by the kernel for this hardware'
items.existing_fix_owner: none (applesmc-next replaces applesmc and sbs; not packaged)
items.decision: DKMS replacement macbook91-applesmc: pristine applesmc.c per series (6.18.55, 7.2.9) + own patch, power_supply extension on BAT0 mapping charge_control_end_threshold (10..100) to BCLM
items.risk_rollback: replaces an in-tree module; kernels of a series without a source get no build (BUILD_EXCLUSIVE_KERNEL) and a WARNING from the pacman hook; CachyOS 7.3 has no applesmc but its own SMC driver macsmc-acpi, which must not run next to applesmc, so 7.3 stays without a source (docs/FINDINGS.md); pre_remove resets BCLM to 100; rollback: pacman -R or rmmod applesmc + delete updates/dkms/applesmc
items.acceptance: attribute present after boot; BCLM below charge level stops charging on AC; 100 resumes; value survives suspend and reboot; Plasma shows and sets it | PASS: attribute, stop, resume, DKMS load, verify; NOT_RUN: persistence over suspend/reboot, Plasma UI

evidence.ref: SMC key list: BCLM ui8 100; 2026-10-14 prototype: 62 % on AC, BCLM 55 -> 1.22 A to 0 within 15 s, 100 -> 1.8 A
power_supply_core.c v7.2.9 register_extension updates sysfs; PowerDevil 6.7.5 chargethresholdhelper_linux.cpp needs only charge_control_end_threshold
